steps.expected: The markets section shows Add country

steps.title: When the user clicks Add country
steps.expected: The composer opens with a country select and a language select

steps.title: Then the language select is disabled until a country is picked
steps.expected: The language select is greyed and cannot be opened

steps.title: When the user picks a country with several languages
steps.expected: The language select becomes enabled and is prefilled with the default language of the country
steps.data: Country: a multilingual country (e.g. Canada or Switzerland)

steps.title: And the user opens the language select
steps.expected: The default language is listed first, the other languages of the country follow, labels read like "English (EN)" and no "Primary" tag is shown

results.notes: Brand Decathlon (decathlon.com). Add country opens the "Add a country" composer with "Select a country..." and "Select a language..." plus Cancel / Save. Language button disabled (cursor not-allowed, greyed); a forced click opened no list. Country Canada picked: language becomes enabled and prefilled "English (EN)"; list = "English (EN)" (selected, first), "French (FR)"; no "Primary" text anywhere on the page.

results.title: Changing the language of a market row applies

steps.title: Given a market row with its default language
steps.expected: The row shows the country and its language
steps.data: Market: Canada - English (EN) (or another multilingual country)

steps.title: When the user changes the language of the row
steps.expected: The row now shows the new language

steps.title: Then the change applies
steps.expected: The row reads Canada - French (FR); the country cannot be changed in the row (only the language select is editable)

results.notes: Row Canada + English (EN) saved, then its language select (aria-label "Select language for Canada") changed to French (FR): the row shows "Canada" + "French (FR)". The country is a plain text span; the language select is the only control in the row. The row shows country and language as two separate elements, with no literal " - " between them.

results.notes: ANALYSIS CREATED for this TC: Decathlon (decathlon.com), UUID 27bec573-a748-4848-a673-849754cd18e5, org QA-GEO, markets GB (EN) + FR (FR), 1 category (Articles De Sport; second detected category removed), 80 prompts, ChatGPT + Gemini, created 2026-10-19 19:15:57 UTC, API insightsLanguage = "fr". Language for AI Insights is shown below the markets (default English (EN), list starts with English, French, then all languages); set to French (FR). The first collection finished during the run (status COMPLETED). Dashboard and category page: the Identity AI summaries ("Summary generated by artificial intelligence"), the Brand Image / Employer Brand / ESG / Leadership insights and the topic names are in French. The UI labels stay in English (Identity, Performance, Brand Image, Positive...), /auth/me language = en-GB, the GB (EN) prompts stay in English in Manage Scope (40 GB rows), and the other analysis Decathlon a054db66 keeps English insights (insightsLanguage "en"). No block is labelled "InBrief" in the app; the AI summaries checked are the Identity summaries. SIDE FINDING (to triage, not part of this TC verdict): with AI Insights set to French, the discovered category names come out in French ("Articles De Sport", "Équipement De Plein Air", with EN shown only as the translation) and the GB (EN) prompts show Category "Articles De Sport". In the smoke run (AI Insights English) the English name was the row title. Pool ring at Prompts: "600 / 1000 · 80 selected" (U goes from 520 to 600).

steps.expected: The wizard stays on Brand & Country

steps.expected: Discover Categories is disabled

steps.expected: The error clears and Discover Categories is enabled

results.notes: Brand empty, market United Kingdom / English (EN). Before the click Discover Categories is enabled. After the click the wizard stays on /geo/new with Brand & Country current; the brand field box border turns red (oklch 0.637 0.237 25.331 = red-500); "Add your brand to continue." is shown (role=alert); Discover Categories is disabled. While "Decathlon" is only typed (no option picked yet) the error stays and the button stays disabled. Once decathlon.com is picked, the error clears, the border goes back to grey and Discover Categories is enabled.

The loading screen reads "Discovering Categories / Scanning how AI engines see Decathlon across your markets. / This usually takes about 20 seconds. We look at your brand, your markets and their languages." Stepper still marks Brand & Country (aria-current=step); footer Back / Discover Categories not displayed; Back to Dashboard disabled.
